definitions.explanation: Chestnuts roasted with sugar—classically the Tianjin ({天津|てんしん}) variety from China, with peelable shells and a soft, sweet flesh. Sold ready-to-eat at supermarkets, convenience stores, and street stalls in autumn and winter.

examples.japanese: {甘栗|あまぐり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought some sweet roasted chestnuts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{甘栗|あまぐり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{食|た}べたく→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When winter comes, I crave sweet roasted chestnuts.

examples.japanese: ⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{袋入|ふくろい}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{甘栗|あまぐり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦おやつ→おやつ：17921_oyatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{帰|かえ}った→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。

notes:
Compound of {甘|あま} (sweet) + ⟦{栗|くり}→栗：04387_kuri⟧ (chestnut). The most common type sold in Japan is {天津甘栗|てんしんあまぐり} — Tianjin-style sweet chestnuts imported from China, with small, easy-to-peel shells.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {天津|てんしん}{甘栗|あまぐり}: Tianjin-style sweet chestnuts
- {甘栗|あまぐり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{剥|む}く→剥く：02305_muku⟧: to peel sweet chestnuts
- {甘栗|あまぐり}むいちゃいました: "I peeled the chestnuts for you" — a famous brand of pre-peeled {甘栗|あまぐり}

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{栗|くり}→栗：04387_kuri⟧: chestnut — the general term; raw or in any preparation
- ⟦{焼|や}き{栗|ぐり}→焼き栗：24146_yakiguri⟧: roasted chestnuts — broader term not specifying the sweet preparation
